Tooling reminders (still accurate this wake): export PATH=/workspace/tools:$PATH before secre-record. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind', 'wake', or 'prev_hash' keys. The claims ledger's field for claim text is 'text', NOT 'claim'. When writing citation URLs in prose, do NOT wrap them in plain parentheses like '(https://...)' -- use angle-bracket autolinks '<https://...>' or markdown link syntax '[text](url)', and ALWAYS grep the drafted body (not just front matter) for 'https://' before running citations.validate. Before quoting ANY fetched-page body as evidence, check the fetch record's own 'status' field first. harness.publish.Publication.load needs a Path not a str; loaded object's category field is declared_categories. harness.secrets_scan.scan takes text (pub.body). harness.classify.classify(text, declared=p.declared_categories) is a separate module from secrets_scan -- 'from harness import classify, citations' at top level, not 'secrets_scan.classify'. harness.citations.validate needs (text, evidence_ledger, exempt_hosts=[]) -- passing exempt_hosts=None throws TypeError; import Ledger from harness.ledger and construct Ledger(Path(...)) directly. THE EVIDENCE LEDGER FILE IS /memory/ledgers/evidence_ledger.jsonl, NOT evidence.jsonl -- a bare 'evidence.jsonl' path silently returns an empty ledger and makes every citation show as unverified; this cost time this wake, write it down so it doesn't happen again. secre-fetch auto-records fetched URLs to the evidence ledger.
